uutiset.t: Who to watch in Spain's election race
uutiset.s: Spain votes on 29 November, with the conservatives leading most polls after eight years of Socialist-led rule.

uutiset.t: Democrats win Alaska Senate race two weeks after midterms counting began
uutiset.s: Confirmation of Mary Peltola's victory caps of the party's rout of the Republicans in the midterms Senate election.

uutiset.t: Ghana's new $60m presidential jet sparks public outrage
uutiset.s: The purchase has sparked outrage over its cost as many Ghanaians struggle with rising cost of living.

uutiset.t: Philippines police ask prosecutors to charge Thomas Markle over child sex abuse material
uutiset.s: Markle is being held in custody in the US after one charge and has previously denied all of the allegations.

uutiset.t: Can a US-backed mineral highway bring peace and prosperity to DR Congo?
uutiset.s: The Lobito Corridor is at the centre of a US-backed effort to secure access to Africa's critical minerals.

uutiset.t: Rubio says US not 'under systemic attack' after series of tech outages
uutiset.s: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said there was "zero evidence" supporting theories online that recent disruptions affecting Microsoft, banks and flights are connected.

uutiset.t: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as it reports soaring sales
uutiset.s: The AI chip giant reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday after the dramatic exit of Jensen Huang.

uutiset.t: Millions of red crabs start annual migration on Christmas Island
uutiset.s: The crabs were seen migrating from forests to the sea to breed on the coast of the Australian territory.

uutiset.t: As Trump and Xi meet, China's AI dreams face an unexpected hurdle: the Nvidia spy scandal
uutiset.s: China worries the scandal could ramp up pressure on the US to further restrict the sale of advanced chips.

uutiset.t: American soldier arrested by UK police on suspicion of spying taken into US military custody
uutiset.s: The Metropolitan Police say he has been taken into custody by the US Military over suspected national security and espionage allegations.

uutiset.t: Putin's Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine
uutiset.s: Ukraine says the missile and drone attack on the strategic bridge in the Russian-annexed Crimea took weeks to plan.

uutiset.t: Russian military plane crashes, killing all 19 on board
uutiset.s: Russia's defence ministry says it preliminarily believes a technical malfunction was the cause of the crash in the Kemerovo region.

uutiset.t: US loses measles elimination status after 26 years amid record case numbers
uutiset.s: States have reported over 5,400 cases and 10 measles-related deaths for the first time since the early 1990s.

uutiset.t: Palestinian woman, 72, shot dead by Israeli settlers in West Bank, health ministry says
uutiset.s: Palestinians say there was an attack by settlers in al-Duyuk al-Tahta, while the Israeli military says the settlers fired after being attacked.

uutiset.t: William and Kate celebrate Earthshot Prize winners in Mumbai
uutiset.s: The Prince and Princess of Wales were joined by sporting and acting stars for the annual environmental awards ceremony.
